row: The veterinarians at Horse Plus Humane Society work tirelessly to provide the very best medical care for the horses at the shelter.  From eye enucleations to gelding surgeries, you will always be amazed by the challenges faced by the medical team.   Dr Lydia (part time) and Nicole (full time veterinary technician) are both extremely passionate about animal care and recovering rehabilitating abused and neglected animals.  The medical team relies on your donations to Horse Plus Humane Society, please give now!
